pathogenesis: occurs when lung cells change or mutate and they begin growing and dividing uncontrollably as these mutated cancer cells stacked upon one another form a mass or tumor. If cancer cells from this tumor break off and get into the bloodstream you can develop metastatic lung cancer.
treatments: chemotherapy and radiation for small cell lung cancer, surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation for non-small cell lung cancer depending on the staging of the lung cancer
